page.notes: The catchword "Atq[?]" is partly worn; it may be "Atque" with a abbreviation mark. The "19" before it at the foot right is a verse number for the next verse. The left-margin fragments (hyphens, numbers) belong to the facing page and were left out, except the verse numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35, which belong to this text. Verse 14 "me-diani" is printed with a line-end hyphen.
